# 03.10-courses-controller-migration: Migrate CoursesController (146 API issues, largest — includes file upload) and its Views/Courses folder to net10.0

## Objective
Resolve the 146 issues (128 `Api.0001` + 18 `Api.0002`) in `Controllers/CoursesController.cs` — the largest and last controller subtask, since it includes `HttpPostedFileBase` file-upload handling (`teachingMaterialImage`) which is itself System.Web-specific and needs the adapters bridge (or an `IFormFile`-based rework) fully proven out by the simpler controllers first. Migrate its `Views/Courses/` views (including the two bundling-reference views already handled by 03.02 — do not re-touch those bundling lines here).

Runs after 03.02, and after 03.07/03.08/03.09 have proven out the adapters-bridge pattern for simpler CRUD controllers.

## Scope
`Controllers/CoursesController.cs`, `Views/Courses/*.cshtml`.

## Steps
1. Use `get_code_dependencies` on `CoursesController.cs` to get its full dependency tree (models: `Course`, `Department`; file upload for `TeachingMaterialImagePath`; see [TEACHING_MATERIAL_UPLOAD.md](../../../../../TEACHING_MATERIAL_UPLOAD.md) for existing feature context) before making changes.
2. Work through the `Index`, `Details`, `Create` (x2, incl. `HttpPostedFileBase teachingMaterialImage` upload handling), `Edit` (x2, same upload handling), `Delete`, `DeleteConfirmed` actions, fixing each flagged `System.Web.Mvc` API usage. Pay particular attention to the file-upload code path — confirm whether the adapters bridge (`HttpPostedFileBase`) covers it or whether it needs converting to `IFormFile`.
3. Build and verify 0 API issues remain for this controller/its views.

## Done when
`CoursesController.cs` and `Views/Courses/` build with 0 API issues, and the teaching-material image upload continues to function.

## Research findings (pre-execution)

- **Repo-wide confirmation**: `CoursesController.cs` is the *only* remaining file with `using System.Web.Mvc;` / `using System.Web;` in the entire codebase (grepped `using System\.Web`). All other controllers (Instructors, Students, Departments, Home, Notifications) already migrated to `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc` with `IActionResult` / `Controller` / `NotFound()` / `BadRequest()` conventions — no adapters-bridge (`System.Web.Mvc`-shim) pattern was used anywhere else. This confirms the established project convention: full rewrite to native ASP.NET Core MVC types, not bridging via System.Web Adapters.
- **`get_code_dependencies`** on `CoursesController.cs`: depends on `BaseController` (already migrated, `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Controller`), `Course`/`Department`/etc. models (POCOs, unaffected), `SchoolContext`/`SchoolContextFactory` (EF Core, unaffected), `NotificationService`. No other System.Web-dependent types in the graph.
- **File-upload decision (`HttpPostedFileBase` vs adapters bridge vs `IFormFile`)**: `Microsoft.AspNetCore.SystemWebAdapters` is referenced in the csproj and wired in `Program.cs` (`AddSystemWebAdapters()`/`UseSystemWebAdapters()`), but nothing in the app actually consumes its `System.Web.HttpContext`-shim surface — it bridges `HttpContext`/`Session`/etc., not `System.Web.Mvc` controller/action-result/model-binding types like `ActionResult`, `SelectList`, or `HttpPostedFileBase`, none of which are part of the adapters package's shimmed surface. Since every other controller in this repo already fully rewrote to native ASP.NET Core MVC (not adapter shims), the decision is: **convert `HttpPostedFileBase teachingMaterialImage` to `IFormFile teachingMaterialImage`** (native ASP.NET Core model binding for uploads), not attempt to keep it via the adapters bridge.
  - `teachingMaterialImage.ContentLength` → `teachingMaterialImage.Length`
  - `teachingMaterialImage.SaveAs(filePath)` → `using (var stream = new FileStream(filePath, FileMode.Create)) { teachingMaterialImage.CopyTo(stream); }`
  - `teachingMaterialImage.FileName` — same property name on `IFormFile`, no change needed.
- **`Server.MapPath(...)` (4 call sites)**: `Controller` in ASP.NET Core has no `Server`/`HttpServerUtility` property. Replaced with an injected `IWebHostEnvironment` and a small private `MapPath(string virtualPath)` helper that strips the `~/` prefix and combines with `ContentRootPath` (parity with classic `Server.MapPath("~/...")`, which maps to the app root, not `wwwroot`). `CoursesController` gains its first constructor in this codebase (`IWebHostEnvironment` via DI) — no other controller currently has one.
- **Static file serving gap (functional requirement, not just compile fix)**: `Uploads/TeachingMaterials/` lives at the project root, **not** under `wwwroot/`, and `Program.cs` only calls `app.UseStaticFiles()` for the default `wwwroot` provider. Existing/new images stored under `~/Uploads/...` and rendered via `@Url.Content(...)` in the views would 404 without an additional static-file mapping. Added a second `app.UseStaticFiles(...)` in `Program.cs` scoped to `RequestPath = "/Uploads"` backed by a `PhysicalFileProvider` over `ContentRootPath/Uploads`, so the "teaching-material image upload continues to function" done-criterion is actually met end-to-end. This is a one-line-block addition to `Program.cs`, outside the stated file scope but required by the task's own functional acceptance criterion; called out here as a deviation.
- **Views/Courses/*.cshtml**: none of the 5 views (`Index`, `Details`, `Create`, `Edit`, `Delete`) reference `System.Web.Mvc` types directly or contain `@Scripts.Render`/`@Styles.Render` bundling calls — they use only `Html.BeginForm`, `Html.LabelFor/EditorFor/ValidationMessageFor`, `Html.DropDownList`, `Html.DisplayFor/DisplayNameFor`, `Url.Content`, all of which exist with compatible overloads in ASP.NET Core's `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ViewFeatures.HtmlHelper` (already proven working, unchanged, in the already-migrated Instructors/Students views). No view edits are expected to be required; verified by build after controller changes.
- **`[Bind(Include = "...")]`** → does not exist in ASP.NET Core; converted to the multi-arg `[Bind("CourseID","Title","Credits","DepartmentID","TeachingMaterialImagePath")]` form, matching the pattern already used in the migrated `InstructorsController`.
- **`HttpStatusCodeResult`/`HttpNotFound()`** → `BadRequest()` / `NotFound()` per the `migrating-mvc-controllers` skill's MVC return-type mapping table; `using System.Net;` becomes unused and is removed.
